response.sql: WITH circuit_avg AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) as circuit_avg_round FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(r.round) as country_avg_round FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_avg_round, ca.circuit_avg_round - coa.country_avg_round as difference FROM circuit_avg ca INNER JOIN country_avg coa ON ca.country = coa.country ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
